gloss: to become serious; to worsen; to intensify

definitions.gloss: to become serious; to worsen; to intensify
definitions.explanation: For a problem, situation, or condition to grow more severe or critical over time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{深刻化|しんこくか}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{人手|ひとで}{不足|ぶそく}→人手不足：11436_hitodebusoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{年々|ねんねん}→年々：10417_nennen⟧{深刻化|しんこくか}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The labor shortage is worsening year by year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}らなければ→取る：00565_toru⟧、⟦{環境|かんきょう}{汚染|おせん}→環境汚染：21102_kankyouosen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さらに{深刻化|しんこくか}するだろう。
examples.english: If measures are not taken, environmental pollution will likely become even more serious.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{深刻|しんこく}→深刻：01567_shinkoku⟧ (serious, grave) + ⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧ (transformation) + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Describes a situation deteriorating or escalating in severity. Very common in news reporting and formal discussions about social issues.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{深刻化|しんこくか}する: a problem becomes serious
- ⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{深刻化|しんこくか}する: the situation worsens
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{深刻化|しんこくか}する: damage intensifies
- ⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧{深刻化|しんこくか}する: to become increasingly serious

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悪化|あっか}する→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧: to worsen — more general, can describe any deterioration including health or weather, while {深刻化|しんこくか}する specifically implies reaching a critical or alarming level
- ⟦{激化|げきか}→激化：13372_gekika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to intensify — emphasizes growing violence or fierceness, often used for conflicts or competition
